nodes.description: State variable zethr, a ZethrInterface instance hard-coded to the Zethr token contract address; external contract used for token purchases and balance queries.
State variable bankroll, the address that receives the proxy contract balance when sendDivsToBankroll is called; writable via changeBankroll.
State variable owner, initialized to msg.sender at deployment and used as the sole access-control authority for privileged functions.
External payable function that reads the caller's token balance before and after calling zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value) and emits onTokenPurchase with the minted token amount.
Payable fallback function that accepts plain Ether transfers without any logic or state update.
Privileged function guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) that rewrites the bankroll state variable to _newBankroll.
Privileged function guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) that forwards the entire contract balance to bankroll via transfer.
Untrusted caller-controlled address used for owner initialization, token purchase targeting, balance queries and privilege checks.
External payable call to the untrusted Zethr contract forwarding msg.value; executes arbitrary external code before the post-call balance read, enabling reentrancy.
Unsigned subtraction of balanceBefore from balanceAfter used to derive tokensMinted; can underflow if the post-call balance is lower than the pre-call balance.
External transfer of the whole contract balance to the bankroll address, which executes recipient code and can reenter or fail.
Privileged state write assigning _newBankroll to the bankroll storage variable.
External static call to the untrusted Zethr contract to read the token balance of an address; return value feeds the minted-amount arithmetic.
Parameter of buyTokensWithProperEvent holding the referrer address forwarded to zethr.buyAndTransfer and to the onTokenPurchase event.
Parameter of buyTokensWithProperEvent selecting the dividend rate passed into zethr.buyAndTransfer.
Parameter of changeBankroll holding the new bankroll address written to storage.
Local variable in buyTokensWithProperEvent caching the caller's token balance prior to the purchase.
Local variable in buyTokensWithProperEvent caching the caller's token balance after the purchase.

edges.reason: owner state variable is initialized directly from msg.sender at contract deployment.
msg.sender is the beneficiary of buyTokensWithProperEvent; its balance is read and tokens are transferred to it.
msg.sender is passed as the target address argument of the external zethr.buyAndTransfer call.
msg.sender is supplied as the owner argument of the external zethr.balanceOf call.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates changeBankroll, so the untrusted caller must equal the stored owner.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates sendDivsToBankroll, so the untrusted caller must equal the stored owner.
The owner state variable is the reference value compared against msg.sender in changeBankroll's access-control check.
The owner state variable is the reference value compared against msg.sender in sendDivsToBankroll's access-control check.
The return value of zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) is stored into balanceBefore.
The return value of zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) after the purchase is stored into balanceAfter.
balanceBefore is a subtraction operand in balanceAfter - balanceBefore, whose unsigned result can underflow.
balanceAfter is a subtraction operand in balanceAfter - balanceBefore, whose unsigned result can underflow.
_referredBy is the caller-supplied parameter consumed by buyTokensWithProperEvent.
divChoice is the caller-supplied parameter consumed by buyTokensWithProperEvent.
_referredBy is forwarded as an argument into the external zethr.buyAndTransfer call.
divChoice is forwarded as the dividend-rate argument into the external zethr.buyAndTransfer call.
_newBankroll is written into the bankroll storage slot by the assignment operation.
The bankroll state variable is the storage slot mutated by the assignment in changeBankroll.
The bankroll state variable provides the recipient address for the outgoing transfer.
buyTokensWithProperEvent executes the external zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value) call.
buyTokensWithProperEvent performs the balanceAfter - balanceBefore subtraction to compute tokensMinted.
buyTokensWithProperEvent invokes zethr.balanceOf before and after the purchase.
changeBankroll performs the privileged bankroll assignment only after the owner check passes.
sendDivsToBankroll executes bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance), forwarding the whole contract balance.
The external call to the untrusted Zethr contract can reenter buyTokensWithProperEvent before the post-call balance query completes, altering the minted-amount computation.
bankroll.transfer executes code at the bankroll address and could reenter sendDivsToBankroll, though the recipient is owner-controlled.
